capabilities: Count typed and pasted words automatically as you write
Run timed writing sprints with stretch goals
Build streaks by hitting a daily word-count target
Compete on leaderboards with other writers
Sync stats with the Writing Habit platform and view them in a sidebar panel
extras: Tracks only word counts, never note content, according to the README's privacy section; stats sync through the external Writing Habit service.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count shows only per-file counts, with no persistent daily totals, streaks, timed sprints, or comparison with other writers.
summary: Writing tracker that counts typed and pasted words as you write, and syncs sprints, streaks, and leaderboards with a Writing Habit account.
